name: Data Lakehouse
valueProposition: A senior-level data engineering portfolio project demonstrating a local Modern Data Stack (MDS) implementation. It showcases multi-stage ETL orchestration, a federated query layer for disparate data sources (S3-compatible storage and DuckDB), and advanced performance observability using the Trino REST API.

animations.description: Visualisation of the backpressure handling mechanism during peak traffic spikes.
Dynamic DAG generation logic for multi-tenant data transformation jobs.

mermaidDiagram:
graph TD
    subgraph Ingestion_Layer [Ingestion Layer]
        A[Python Scrapers: BeautifulSoup/Boto3] -->|Scrape Match Results| B(Bronze Layer: MiniO)
    end

    subgraph Storage_Layer [Storage Layer]
        B -->|Parquet Files| C{Apache Airflow}
        C -->|ETL & Modeling| D(Silver/Gold Layers: DuckDB)
    end

    subgraph Query_Layer [Federated Query Engine]
        E[Trino SQL Interface] -->|Federated Query| B
        E -->|Federated Query| D
    end

    subgraph Observability_Layer [Observability]
        F[Custom Monitoring Utility] -->|Extract EXPLAIN ANALYZE| E
    end

    subgraph Infrastructure
        G[Docker Compose] --- Ingestion_Layer
        G --- Storage_Layer
        G --- Query_Layer
    end

name: MLOps
valueProposition: A production-grade MLOps showcase that prioritizes architectural simplicity and statistical interpretability. It replaces standard 'black-box' classification with a Poisson-distributed Latent Strength Model, enabling high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations for football match forecasting while maintaining a local-first, containerized developer experience.

animations.description: Synchronisation logic between offline training data and online serving cache.

graph TD

    end

    subgraph Modeling_Layer [Modeling & Tracking]
        B -->|Historical Match Data| C[Statsmodels / SciPy]
        C -->|Poisson GLM Fitting| D{MLflow}
        D -->|Coefficients & Metadata| E(Model Registry)
    end

    subgraph Inference_Layer [Inference & UI]
        E -->|Stored Parameters| F[Streamlit Dashboard]
        F -->|Monte Carlo Simulation| G(Match Outcome Probabilities)
    end

    subgraph Infrastructure [DevOps & DX]
        H[Docker Compose] --- Data_Layer
        H --- Modeling_Layer
        H --- Inference_Layer
        I[Multi-stage Docker Build] --> H
        J[Makefile] -->|One-command Setup| H
    end

name: Real-Time Data
valueProposition: A high-throughput, local-first streaming architecture for browser resource telemetry. It implements a 'Kappa' architecture using the Chrome DevTools Protocol, Redpanda, and DuckDB to provide real-time, privacy-preserving insights into memory, network, and lifecycle performance without the overhead of traditional polling.

animations.description: LSTM neural network identifying vibration outliers in real-time.

graph TD
    subgraph Ingestion_Layer [Ingestion Layer]

        B -->|Producer: Stream Telemetry| C{Redpanda}
    end

    subgraph Processing_Layer [Stream Processing & Storage]
        C -->|Consumer: Micro-batching| D[Vectorised Python Processing]
        D -->|State Reconstruction| E[(DuckDB: Parquet-backed)]
    end

    subgraph Visualization_Layer [Insights & UI]
        E -->|Analytical Queries| F[Streamlit Dashboard]
        F -->|Visualise| G[Zombie Tab Detector / Network Surges]
    end

    subgraph Infrastructure
        H[Docker Compose] --- Ingestion_Layer
        H --- Processing_Layer
        H --- Visualization_Layer
    end

name: GenAI
valueProposition: An end-to-end security research pipeline that replaces regex-based static analysis with structural reasoning. By constructing a Code Property Graph (CPG) and enriching it with NVD/CWE intelligence, it enables a local LLM to identify complex logic flaws and data-flow vulnerabilities like 'Sinks' and 'Sources' with high precision.

animations.description: Neo4j graph traversal identifying money laundering patterns.

mermaidDiagram:
graph TD
    subgraph Ingestion [Data Engineering Layer]
        A[NVD/CVE JSON] -->|Ingest| B[(Neo4j Knowledge Graph)]
        C[MITRE CWE XML] -->|Ingest| B
    end

    subgraph Extraction [Code Analysis Layer]
        D[Target Source Code] -->|Tree-sitter / PyCG| E[Abstract Syntax Tree]
        E -->|Map Structural Relationships| B
        B -->|Result| F{Code Property Graph}
    end

    subgraph Inference [Audit & Orchestration]
        F -->|Cypher Pathfinding| G[Orchestrator]
        G -->|Prompt + Context| H[Ollama: DeepSeek-Coder-V2]
        H -->|Reasoning| I[Final Vulnerability Report]
    end

    subgraph Infrastructure
        J[Docker Compose] --- Ingestion
        J --- Extraction
        J --- Inference
    end
